title: HarnessForge end-to-end scenario suite: real portal (headless Chromium) and real CLI launcher

commit.working_tree: uncommitted changes present (775 entries in git status --porcelain: documentation reorganisation plus benchmark files)

environment.server_command: cd <repo> && PORT=8867 HARNESSFORGE_WORKSPACE=<scratch>/e2e-ws PHX_SERVER=true mix phx.server > docs/benchmarks/2026-11-08/e2e/server.log 2>&1 (MIX_ENV=dev, not a release build)
environment.cli_launcher: bin/harnessforge (mix run -e HarnessForge.CLI.main; boots the BEAM on every call)
environment.concurrency: The CLI suite ran in the background while the first (partial) browser run executed; the final browser run (results below) and the two repeats ran after the CLI suite had finished. The repeats used port 8868 and fresh workspaces e2e-ws-rep2 / e2e-ws-rep3 while the main server on 8867 stayed up.

commands.name: server start (background, first instance; stopped after the partial run)
commands.command: cd <repo> && PORT=8867 HARNESSFORGE_WORKSPACE=<scratch>/e2e-ws PHX_SERVER=true mix phx.server > <repo>/docs/benchmarks/2026-11-08/e2e/server.log 2>&1

commands.name: readiness poll
commands.command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:8867/ every 1 s (first instance) / 0.1 s (second instance) until the code is not 000

commands.name: browser suite (partial run 1, B10 selector bug, archived in run1-partial/)
commands.command: HARNESSFORGE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8867 HARNESSFORGE_WORKSPACE=<scratch>/e2e-ws BENCH_OUT=<e2e dir> E2E_EXPORT_ROOT=<scratch>/e2e-exports-browser node bench/e2e.cjs

commands.name: server stop + fresh workspace
commands.command: lsof -ti :8867 | xargs kill; poll lsof until the port is free; rm -rf <scratch>/e2e-ws and the browser export root

commands.name: server start (background, second instance = results below)
commands.command: cd <repo> && PORT=8867 HARNESSFORGE_WORKSPACE=<scratch>/e2e-ws PHX_SERVER=true mix phx.server > <repo>/docs/benchmarks/2026-11-08/e2e/server.log 2>&1

commands.name: browser suite (final run)
commands.command: HARNESSFORGE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8867 HARNESSFORGE_WORKSPACE=<scratch>/e2e-ws BENCH_OUT=<e2e dir> E2E_EXPORT_ROOT=<scratch>/e2e-exports-browser node bench/e2e.cjs

commands.name: browser suite repeats 2 and 3 (timing)
commands.command: for rep in 2 3: PORT=8868 HARNESSFORGE_WORKSPACE=<scratch>/e2e-ws-rep$rep PHX_SERVER=true mix phx.server > repeat$rep/server.log 2>&1 &; poll curl every 0.1 s; HARNESSFORGE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8868 HARNESSFORGE_WORKSPACE=<that workspace> BENCH_OUT=<e2e dir>/repeat$rep E2E_EXPORT_ROOT=<scratch>/e2e-exports-rep$rep node bench/e2e.cjs; lsof -ti :8868 | xargs kill

commands.name: server stop (end)
commands.command: lsof -ti :8867 | xargs kill; poll lsof -ti :8867 until empty (see server-stop.txt)

caveats: MIX_ENV=dev server (code reloader, debug logging, asset watchers), not a release build.

The access token was read only inside bench/e2e.cjs and never printed, logged, screenshotted or stored; the login screenshots were taken before the field was filled (B01) and before the real code was typed (B02).
The single browser console error per run is the expected "Failed to load resource: 401 (Unauthorized)" from the deliberate wrong-code POST in B02.
B10 asserts the task evaluation ends as blocked (data-outcome="blocked", text BLOCKED, no PASS); no isolated runtime exists on this host.
opencode was built with version 1.0.0 (the adapter accepts unqualified or any 1.x version); claude_code 2.1.311 and codex 0.156.0 are the exact accepted versions.
The first browser run (run1-partial/) failed B10 because of a selector bug in the new test script; it was fixed and the whole suite was rerun from a fresh workspace and a fresh server instance.
